d: Watch as Firstpost examines Nigeria’s major strategic shift as President Bola Tinubu reaches out to Ibrahim Traoré, Assimi Goïta, and Abdourahamane Tchiani of the Alliance of Sahel States to rebuild military cooperation and overhaul the Multinational Joint Task Force. Following the Sahel bloc's exit from ECOWAS, severe cross-border security vulnerabilities around the Lake Chad basin have allowed radical extremist groups like Boko Haram and JNIM to aggressively expand their operational reach across West Africa.
